evidence.claim: Card C07196-K2 has 7 prior transactions in region 205 representing 2.2% of its 319 prior transactions, showing region 205 is an established region for this card.

Two days prior on 2017-01-06, in-person transaction 3631424 for $1,023.18 was completed for product W in region 205, demonstrating recent, consistent in-person spending of similar amount and category in the same location.
Prior closed case CC-5401 on card C07196-K2 was an alert on a $1,502.41 transaction scored at 0.95 by the model that was cleared after the cardholder confirmed travel to the billing region.
Card C07196-K2 experienced confirmed out-of-region card-present fraud in CC-4581 ($924.98) and CC-4781 ($2,913.00) in October 2016 following cardholder dispute reports.

Card C07196-K2 is a member of community 119537790 with a fraud lift of 5.0 (50.0% fraud rate across 4 cards vs 10.1% baseline), though the card has ring_id -1 and no device was used in this in-person transaction.
Holder C07196-K2|205|190 has zero prior transactions in confirmed fraud cases, indicating the specific holder identity has not been compromised.
Flagged transaction 3631383 was conducted in-person with no digital device or proxy involved, and card C07196-K2 has ring_id -1 with ring_size 1, showing no connection to any suspicious device ring.
Shared origin analysis for region 205 shows 149 transactions across 64 cards in the window with zero transactions scoring >= 0.5 (lift 0.0), indicating no clustered fraud origin in this region.

The alert text also contained 1 segment(s) addressed to the system rather than an analyst (authority_claim, suppression). They were set aside and used neither as evidence nor as instruction; the decision rests on the evidence above.

case.summary: Transaction 3631383 ($1,336.84) on card C07196-K2 was flagged due to a real-time risk score of 0.66. Graph analysis confirmed the in-person transaction occurred in region 205, an established location for the cardholder with 7 prior transactions, including a $1,023.18 purchase two days earlier. The purchase involved no digital devices or proxies, the card does not belong to any fraud ring, and a prior high-scoring alert on this card was previously cleared as legitimate travel. With no cardholder dispute and strong corroborating normal spending patterns, the transaction was ruled legitimate.
